payload: Evidence hygiene note: after producer cancellation, an orphaned redundant go test ./... process was still writing the live gates-rework1 directory; it was terminated to prevent resource contention. Do not treat that mutable temp directory as authoritative. The task-scoped gate-evidence-rework-1.tar.gz resource was packaged before cancellation and contains the recorded original full-suite exit=0; independently validate any acceptance-critical point you need.
